product_goal: Market monitoring / risk awareness engine combining multimodal ingestion (OHLCV + news), temporal neural modeling, graph dependency modeling, and an AlphaFusionNet fusion/reasoning layer. Outputs are descriptive/diagnostic and must not be used as investment advice.
merge_goal: Provide a merge-ready, architecture-oriented dossier: module boundaries, entrypoints, runtime orchestration, and stable contracts (APIs, Celery tasks, Mongo collections, ClickHouse expectations, filesystem artifacts), including submodule topology for safe refactoring and future merges.
repo_type: multi-service python orchestrator with nested git submodules

modules.name: AlphaFusionNet (Fusion + Policy/Reasoning)
modules.responsibility: Fuse NeuralFusionCore signed weights with NetWeaver predicted-return scores using a configurable alpha and optional LLM-generated policy JSON; persist final weights, risk_controls, and reasoning to MongoDB; serve latest/historical results via FastAPI.

modules.name: ChronoBridge (Ingest + Features + Embeddings)
modules.responsibility: Fetch OHLCV from ClickHouse and news from MongoDB, push to Redis, build feature parquet datasets, generate synchronized inputs, and persist fused embeddings to MongoDB for downstream consumption.
depends_on: Transformer model artifacts (BigBird tokenizer/model files under apps/ChronoBridge/models/)

modules.name: NeuralFusionCore (Temporal+News model)
modules.responsibility: Train and run inference for multimodal temporal+news fusion model; emits signed long/short portfolio weights; persists to MongoDB and a JSON file consumed by AlphaFusionNet.

modules.name: NetWeaver (Graph dependency model)
modules.responsibility: Train and predict a graph model describing cross-symbol dependencies and producing a ranking/score (predicted_return) per symbol; emits Top-20 selection CSV consumed by AlphaFusionNet.

modules.name: Scheduler (Celery)
modules.responsibility: Orchestrates daily workflows, prediction windows, and metrics; enforces trading-day gating; runs steps by invoking Python modules via subprocess.

modules.name: Metrics (Live + Monthly + Backtesting)
modules.responsibility: Compute per-minute NAV snapshots over live windows and month-to-date aggregate metrics; persist to MongoDB collections windows/live_metrics/monthly.

db.notes: OHLCV table configured via AlphaFusionNet/config/AFN_config.yaml (env-substituted). Expected columns include symbol, candle_time, close (and likely OHLCV fields).

critical_flows: Celery initial_run: compute_trading_days_service -> ChronoBridge ingest+features(train) -> NeuralFusionCore train -> ChronoBridge bridge + API -> NetWeaver train
Celery daily_update: ChronoBridge ingest(latest) -> ChronoBridge features(finetune) -> NeuralFusionCore finetune -> ChronoBridge bridge -> NetWeaver finetune
Celery prediction_14_30PM: ChronoBridge synchronize window -> NeuralFusionCore prediction -> NetWeaver prediction -> alphafusionnet_service -> metric_live scheduling -> metric_monthly

important_files.why: Orchestration truth source: defines all workflows and subprocess calls
Main fusion runtime, Mongo persistence, risk_controls handling

Defines NeuralFusionCore output payload stored in Mongo and JSON
Defines NetWeaver prediction process and output file locations

risks: Nested submodules and duplicated code copies (e.g., NeuralFusionCore appears both at apps/NeuralFusionCore and inside apps/ChronoBridge/apps/NeuralFusionCore).
Submodule fork policy not configured: AlphaFusionNet/memory-bank/submodule_overrides.json is a template.
Windows shell differences: some docs/scripts assume bash chaining; Celery on Windows uses threads pool.
Secrets required at runtime (.env, OPENAI_API_KEY, DB creds) must not be committed.
LLM client uses legacy openai<1.0.0 ChatCompletion API; may require modernization.
Large ML artifacts (weights, safetensors) can bloat repo; consider Git LFS policies.
